articleTitle: A Model for Simulation of the Temperature Field of Flexible Printed Circuit Boards
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The thermal regime of electronic modules is crucial for their reliable and trouble-free operation. In this study is developed a model for simulation of the temperature field of flexible printed circuit boards (PCB). It relies on the Finite difference method and physical dependencies and was implemented in a software tool for simulation. An experimental set-up was prepared in order to validate the developed model. A flexible PCB with a voltage regulator was powered and its temperature transient response was recorded with the thermal camera. The temperatures were analyzed by dividing the observed area into 6 zones and their average value was obtained. The validation of the model was implemented by comparing the experimental and modelled transient response of the first and the last temperature zones. The relative error varies between 0.11 and $5 \%$, with the lowest values being under steady-state conditions and the highest - in the initial stages of the transient response. The developed model could be used for analysis the temperature field of flexible PCBs under different exploitation conditions.

articleTitle: Microgrid Model for Evaluating the Operational Dynamics of Solar-Powered Hydrogen Production
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Solar energy technology plays a pivotal role in the sustainable generation of hydrogen. While traditional methods rely on fossil fuels like natural gas, coal, and oil, this study delves into eco-friendly alternatives. Despite the higher cost, green hydrogen has spurred the development of cost-effective, low-carbon technologies. A microgrid model is presented, featuring a self-contained DC islanded system supplying power to an electrolyzer using solar arrays and energy storage. This model serves as a versatile tool for evaluating the operational dynamics of sustainable hydrogen production. Over a week-long timeframe, it assesses hydrogen generation characteristics, leveraging solar energy directly or via integrated energy storage. With a multi-domain framework covering electrical, thermal liquid, and thermal gas aspects, the model offers a holistic exploration of green hydrogen production processes. Through simulation, the feasibility and efficiency of renewable energy-based hydrogen production in off-grid scenarios are examined, contributing to sustainable energy solutions.

articleTitle: Using of Four-Dimensional Electromagnetic Potentials in Cases of Movement. Part II: Examples
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This work shown application of four-dimensional potential in case of moving. Two cases for application of fourdimensional potential for determining of the vectors of the induced electric field and magnetic field by motion in Minkovski space are considered. The electromagnetic field vectors are defined as elements of dual Maxwell’s tensor. The elements of four-dimensional electric potential are electric vector-potential and scalar magnetic potential, respectively. A variable magnetic charge model is used in case of determination of electric vector-potential. The relation between the four-dimensional electric potential and the corresponding field tensors is used for determination of electrical field components in case of movement.

articleTitle: Development of the Primary Root System After Pre-Sowing Electromagnetic Treatments of Cotton Seeds Stored Under Natural Ageing Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper presents the results obtained from laboratory studies after pre-sowing electromagnetic treatments of cotton seeds of the variety „Chirpan 539“. The lengths and mass of the plant roots were studied. The seeds were divided into three groups and were stored under natural aging conditions. The first group of seeds was stored for 3 years, the second group for 2 years and the third group for 1 year until the date of the test. A three-step electromagnetic treatment of the seeds was applied with controlled variables voltage $\mathrm{U}, \mathrm{KV}$ and duration of exposure $\tau, \mathrm{s}$. The parameters of the pre-sowing electromagnetic treatments, which produced a stimulating effect on the sowing properties of old seeds, were established. In seeds stored for 1 year prior to the pre-sowing electromagnetic treatment, a positive effect on the length and mass of the roots was found. These increased to $117.6 \%$ /C and $119.9 \% / \mathrm{C}$, respectively. For a positive effect of the pre-sowing electromagnetic treatment of cotton seeds of the variety, „Chirpan 539“, treatment with values of the controlled variables as per variant 4 is proposed: $U_{1}=6 \mathrm{KV}$ and $\tau_{1}=5 \mathrm{~s}, \mathrm{U}_{2}=4.5 \mathrm{KV}$ and $\tau_{2}=15 \mathrm{~s}, \mathrm{U}_{3}=3 \mathrm{KV}$ и $\tau_{3}=25 \mathrm{~s}$.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Automatic Drip Irrigation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: To optimize the irrigation process this paper presents a new automatic drip irrigation automatic equipment. This equipment can be useful for small surfaces for drip irrigation to compensate the lack of humidity of the soil. For this purpose, this project uses controllers. The process is fully automatic, and the software conceived uses this equipment for a homogeneous soil of uniform granularity. The operation of this equipment can be extended for irrigation of any type of predefined soil.

articleTitle: Real-Time IoT System for Monitoring of Indoor Comfort and Health in Office Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents a new model of real-time smart IoT system which is dedicated to monitoring both indoor comfort and health in office buildings. The developed model uses an Arduino development board as well as multiple sensors and can be extended or customized according to the user needs. The system has been preliminary tested, on a 14-days period (03/11/2024-03/25/2024) in one office space and has registered the meteorological parameters (temperature, humidity) and other several pollutants concentrations. These have proved to mostly fall in the recommended intervals envisaging a suitable working environment for the office space occupants.

articleTitle: Pressure Gradient Resulting from Turbulent and Viscous Friction in Smooth Pipes
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the case of irrigation processes involving irrigation pipelines, the determination of pressure losses is imperative in order to optimize the irrigation pipe network and to increase energy efficiency. In general, hydraulically smooth pipes are applied for irrigation activities, especially in drip irrigation, where they are manufactured from PE and applied to irrigation wings or laterals, distributing irrigation water following a specific scheme according to the type of agricultural crops irrigated. In this sense, the turbulent flows in smooth pipes cause in one time activity of turbulent and viscosity tangential tensions, which are various and dependence of distance to inside surface of the pipes and values of Reynolds number. This tensions generate pressure losses and their distribution and values are necessary for practice and science investigation, so that they are subject of this paper. As a result are shown analytical regularities about the distribution and values of the pressure losses expressed as a pressure gradient, realized in a cross section of the flow and along the hydraulically smooth pipe area.

articleTitle: A Comparation between Some Properties of Electric and Compressed Air Cars
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents a review concerning the main advantages and disadvantages of compressed air. A comparison with the other types of vehicles was made. The experience and data from other researchers are used. Performance calculated at the conditions of Bulgaria and $E U-27$ are presented. The results show the main advantages and main problems of the compressed air vehicles during the exploitation. A number of representative and useful diagrams are given.

articleTitle: Examining the Changes in Pressure Regulator Characteristics of Automatic Transmissions After Prolonged Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The present paper examines the change in the characteristics of the linear pressure solenoids (electronic pressure regulators), integrated into the automatic transmissions of the 09G/K/M type range found in cars pertaining to the VAG company group, after reaching a certain mileage. Designed and constructed, accordingly, is a specialized hydraulic test bench, complete with an integrated electronic control system for an in-depth analysis of pressure characteristics. The methodology used for testing the solenoids on the bench is specifically tailored to replicate the conditions they encounter within the gearbox itself. Explored, additionally, is the possibility for repairing faulty solenoids and restoring their functionality.

articleTitle: Results from the Application of a Remote Photovoltaic Lab in STEM Education
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This study presents the results of a STEM-based education with binary lessons in the subjects “Physics and astronomy” and “Informatics” in a Bulgarian high school. It relies on a previously developed remote Arduino-based photovoltaic laboratory. A curriculum was developed, that consists of 5 topics, 2h each. It covers different parts of the two subjects, such as Ohm’s law, measuring voltage and current, measurement errors, renewable energy sources, working with Arduino, wireless communication, Internet of Things. A survey was conducted among the students after the implementation of the binary lessons. It showed that this approach had a positive impact on their motivation, interest in the subjects and ability to gain knowledge. It also showed that some of the students experience problems with some of the topics, which should allow to tune them up in the future.

articleTitle: A Computational Approach for Predicting the Short-Term Output Power of a Wind Turbine in an Urban Area
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper presents an approach aimed at estimating the anticipated power output of a wind turbine by leveraging real-time and forecasted wind speed data sourced from the Internet. The methodology incorporates exponential smoothing techniques to reduce forecasting inaccuracies. Additionally, it introduces a mechanism for data storage and visualization of prediction outcomes on the user interface, enhancing user convenience.

articleTitle: Low Cost Speed Estimator for Marine Generators
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Reliabilityis fundamental to the success of maritime transportation. Ships are tasked with transporting goods, passengers, and resources across vast oceans and waterways, facing diverse environmental conditions and operational challenges. The reliability of ships directly impacts safety, economic viability, and environmental sustainability, making it a critical aspect of maritime operations. The article proposes a low cost technological improvement that will increase the reliability of the ship power plant system, basically for the overall safety of the ship and the ship’ s crew.

articleTitle: Effect of camera orientation angle on UAV crop assessment accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Reflectance indices are very important for precision agriculture. The impact of the orientation angle error when shooting the integrated cameras in the DJI Mavic 2 pro and DJI Phantom 4 pro, as well as an additional mounted MAPIR camera, was investigated. The deviations in the omega/phi/kappa angle uncertainty of the absolute camera positions are analyzed. The relationship between wind speed and camera orientation angle errors was calculated. A strong correlation was obtained R Square is 0.79.

articleTitle: Integrated Assessment of Groundwater Quality: A Case Study of the Roman City and its Northern Surroundings
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Groundwater stands as a crucial natural resource, playing an important role in maintaining the environment and in all human activities worldwide. Regardless of natural or anthropogenic factors, water quality can suffer significant changes due to pressures exerted in the soil. This paper presents qualitative analyses of groundwater, where different physico-chemical parameters of the groundwater in the area are analyzed and monitored. In this study, various analysis techniques were employed, such as spatial analysis, statistical analyses, data comparisons, which were used to evaluate groundwater quality across different spatial and temporal scales. For a better qualitative characterization, the data from the same 12 sampling points were compared both for the year 2021 and 2022. Chemical parameters such as pH, electrical conductivity, total dissolved solids (TDS), calcium, magnesium, total hardness (TH), bicarbonate, chloride, nitrate, and sulfate are analyzed to understand the various geochemical processes affecting groundwater quality. A Water Quality Index was employed, comparing analytical data against standards set by the World Health Organization (WHO) and calculated according to Romanian laws regarding water potability. The results indicate that over $75 \%$ of sampling points fall into the “excellent” class in both years, indicating that the water can be consumed by the population. The variation of nitrate in local wells highlights the need to monitor groundwater for future sustainability.

articleTitle: Creation of Software Management for Water Dynamometer
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper presents a solution for building software control of a water dynamometer test bench for internal combustion engines. The purpose of the created control is to make it possible in working mode for the bench to automatically maintain the resistance force of the dynamometer to the engine, according to preset conditions. On the other hand, it is necessary, when setting certain operating modes with constant and changing values, that the system can reach the required values without external intervention by the operator.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of a resorption heat pump with two useful heating effects
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper shows the advantages for using the ammonia-water solution in a resorption heat pump and the importance of optimizing both the coefficient of performance and the exergetic efficiency as a function of boiling pressure. The most important heating effect is realized through heat recovery from the absorber and the resorber in order to prepare hot water. A second heating effect is obtained through heat recovery from the vapor at the outlet of the vapor generator; this second effect is smaller in value, but the water temperature is higher. The system with two heating effects is characterized by higher values for the exergetic efficiency. This solution answers to some practical application where two temperature levels for the heat are required. The study was performed for different operating conditions of the plant.

articleTitle: Cattle-Based Manure Management and Soil Fertilization System for Labor Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Improving and maintaining soil fertility is a crucial responsibility among essential farming tasks. On cattle farms, the task of collecting and distributing cow manure for soil fertility management has been one of the most substantial shares of the excessive workload for farmers. This paper introduces a novel method for labor-reduced manure management and soil fertilization process, aimed at improving labor efficiency. The proposed approach utilizes an Internet of Things solution that leverages the natural behavior and excretory activities of cattle. Dividing farmlands into smaller units, installed end nodes collect soil nutrient data from each area. Through a centralized web application, farmers can remotely oversee and manage the soil fertility of their entire farmland. Upon a farmer identifying areas with nutrient deficiencies, the proposed system utilizes feeders and bells to attract cattle to these low-fertility areas, encouraging them to deposit manure and enhance soil fertility. The LoRaWAN protocol facilitates bi-directional interaction between farmers located remotely and sensors deployed across vast agricultural landscapes, enabling efficient communication in expansive farming settings.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a 5 kW Photovoltaic Installation for Water Pumping in Rural Areas in Yemen
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This article focuses on the issue of water scarcity in the rural areas of Al-Hudaydah City in Yemen, exacerbated by power shortage and the high cost of diesel for generators. The study proposes a solution in the form of a Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping System (SPVWPS) sized and designed by PVSyst 7.4. This system aims to provide a sustainable and cost-effective method for extracting water from wells to meet the daily needs of the local population to serve approximately 200 families living in nearby villages. The annual amount of water pumped is 27728, the water used is 27702 almost equal to each other with only 0.02% of insufficient water and the system overall efficiency is 74.4%. After accounting for all losses, the operating electrical energy at the pump is available to meet the user’s water needs. The SPVWPS is particularly beneficial in these rural areas where income levels are low and reliance on expensive diesel is not feasible. The implementation of this system signifies a crucial step towards optimal utilization of water and energy resources, a matter of increasing importance for the future.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of a base power deficit in the electric power system
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper considers the main factors, influencing on the risk of a base power shortage in an electric power system. A methodology for assessing the base active power in the electric power system is proposed. The fact that the magnitude of the base active power depends on the composition of the operating generators in the nuclear and thermal power plants, on their capacity and reliability parameters, is taken into account. When forming the risk assessment criteria, it is also taken into account that the systemic failures in electric power systems are regarded as events, causing severe consequences: disruption of stability; cascading shutdown of power lines; abnormal levels of mode parameters. The developed methodology is applied to assess the risk at the moment of occurrence of a base power shortage in various possible events in the electric power system.

articleTitle: Development of a new front heat generator device and results of numerical simulation on Comsole Multiphysics
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the new Kazakhstan, in the agricultural sector, instead of large agricultural holdings, we expect the arrival of small and medium-sized peasant farms, and for them, we must prepare technical means for farming. Therefore, the development of devices of simple design for the efficient combustion of any type of liquid or gaseous fuel of any composition in a compact heat generator for agricultural needs with minimal harmful emissions is an important and urgent task. Previously, we investigated the front device with an air nozzle at a 30° inclination of the front surface to the horizontal, as shown in Fig. 2. But in order to further improve the front device of the heat generator, we increased the angle of inclination to 60° and, through the influence of the intake of secondary air, achieve the division of a single torch into many micro-torches through the cracks in the front device. In this regard, numerical simulation of the heat generator was performed in the Comsol Multiphysics program to study the aerodynamics in the heat generator. Thus, numerical modeling of aerodynamic processes is an important tool in studying the efficiency of the design of the front heat generator device. In the future, the numerical model should be confirmed during experiments on an experimental installation with a complete picture of combustion processes and the formation of complete and incomplete combustion products, optimization of aerodynamics, and mixture formation of fuel and air, as well as the influence of various parameters in these processes on the operation of the front device. In this regard, it is expected to improve the characteristics of the heat generator due to the equalization of the temperature fields of the flame and undesirable fields of underburning of fuel in individual zones of the torch with low mixture formation rates.

articleTitle: Data exchange between distributed energy resources and active customers for stable grid and energy saving by efficient storage
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The increasing share of renewable energy sources in relation to the total generated energy increases the requirements for the flexibility of energy systems. This paper explores some methods and technologies for building an interoperable interface between the IoT devices related to energy consumers and producers in order to allow reliable operation and savings based on demand side management and energy storage. In the particular showcase the IoT devices use public data from the distributes service operator or the energy exchange to reduce the electrical energy cost for the customer, but also to reduce the peaks in the generation profile.

articleTitle: Two-criteria Study of the Fruit Separation Process During Mechanised Harvesting of Tomatoes Variety Bella
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The processes of fruit separation and fruit damage during mechanized harvesting of Bella variety tomatoes were investigated. Controllable factors and optimization parameters are defined. The matrix of the experiment was constructed and a planned three-factor experiment was conducted. The results of the optimization of the regression model of fruiting in the studied regimes show that the fruiting exceeds $97.7 \%$ in the variety Bella and confirms its suitability for mechanized harvesting. The results of the optimization of the regression model of fruit damage under the studied regimes show that damage in the Bella variety can be reduced to $0.05 \%$. The equal response line diagram makes it possible to choose options for the operation mode of the tomato harvester.

articleTitle: Calculation Methods for Energy Conservation in Street Lighting
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: A calculation is a deliberate mathematical process that transforms one or more inputs into one or more outputs or results. A calculation method is a piece of the calculation framework. Diverse calculation method classes are used for different purposes. Purposes could be indicative calculations or precise results. Authors use deemed savings method for indicative calculations and measured savings for precise results for energy conservation in street lighting. Conventional scheme and energy conservation schemes (Dynadimmer Philips, Chronosense Philips, Part Night and adaptive lighting) are compared. The results will serve for design of management platform for IoT street lighting. The article is intended for students, professors and business managers.

articleTitle: Automation System for Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The wind turbine is considered specialized equipment that requires equipment-specific training from the manufacturer’ s side. Local and national laws and regulations should always be consulted when determining safety requirements, training and staff. For the maintenance and performance of the electrical and hydraulic systems, control systems are used for some parameters to protect the generator, the hydraulic system, the converter and the speed reducer. The purpose of this work is to present in detail the temperature control system for cooling the generator, converter and speed reducer at a wind turbine. The “in situ” measurements consist of temperature control monitoring. The obtained results are: the temperature variation for the hydraulic system inverter generator; the temperature variation for the transmission reducer; temperature variation for nacelle cooling-heating fans. Following the results obtained the electrical temperature control schemes can be performed for all the monitored systems.

articleTitle: Animal husbandry production forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Quantitative assessment and forecasting of livestock production is a management task of the business entity. In the paper, a formal model is derived that provides analytical results for the possible level of animal husbandry production. The model is based on auto regression and multiple regression formalization. The model is applied numerically to real data of a dairy farm from the region of Bulgaria. The model uses historical milk yield records from a diary as input and makes analytical predictions for the next production period. A model predictive approach is applied for the consistent output forecasting. Empirical results favor a forecast model that simultaneously applies historical production data and errors between the forecast and past data.

articleTitle: On the Analysis of Power Chain and Dynamics of Electric Cars
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper deals with an effective approach for an optimal design of battery operated electric vehicles with single powered axle. It has been conceived as a complex tool for time-domain analysis of the whole power chain from the battery to the wheels and the related control loops for various operation conditions: acceleration, deceleration with regenerative braking, constant speed on flat road, slope or ramp. A model has been achieved and proven using the available technical specifications of a real-life mass production electric car with permanent magnet synchronous motor driven by a power inverter with vector control strategy. The results of interest are mainly the dynamic performances, the flow of powers from battery to the wheels and vice-versa and other relevant electric quantities. Some results are compared with the technical data specified by the manufacturer to prove the quality of the proposed analysis tool.

articleTitle: Business decision-making in husbandry management
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper makes a formal presentation of models, which are related to business modeling and optimization. The models allow to be quantified relations and defined problems and algorithms for managing a business entity. The models are devoted to optimal inventory management and the relationship of inventory parameters to revenue and production. Portfolio problems for the business management of the farm are derived. The models are empirically tested with real data from the ledger of animal husbandry.

articleTitle: Implementing the Green Deal and CSRD in Bulgaria – a Challenge or an Opportunity for the Business?
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Sustainable development has emerged as a top priority for Europe in the post-COVID era. Effective facilitation of the Green Deal necessitates close collaboration among governments, businesses, and society. The ambitious and challenging initiative of implementing the CSRD regulation is underway. Sustainability reporting is gaining momentum for European corporations and is as relevant for Bulgarian organizations. The objective of the paper is to provide a regulatory overview of the Green Deal and CSRD, as well as to outline challenges and opportunities for their implementation at both national and organizational level in Bulgaria.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Seasonal Coefficient of Performance of Air-to-Water Heat Pumps in Temperate Climate
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the last two decades, a significant increase in the share of heat pump systems, used to maintain the microclimate in residential, public and municipal buildings, has been observed. The electrical energy consumed by this type of machines depends on the coefficient of performance, which in turn is a function of the outside air parameters, as well as on the type of technology used. In the presented study, an attempt is made to determine the seasonal coefficient of performance of heat pump systems, considering three machines of different power, to partially or fully cover the thermal load of the object for which they are proposed. Through the use of four different methodologies, the seasonal coefficient of a given heat pump system, designed to operate in each of the nine considered climate zones in moderate climate conditions, is calculated. The analysis shows that when using a simplified methodology for calculating the seasonal coefficient, the specified coefficient according to the manufacturer’ s technical passport, without taking into account the conditions of the climatic zone, leads to an error in the seasonal coefficient by 20,6%, which is a significant error when calculating the energy consumption. On average, between 5 and 10% is the error in determining the seasonal coefficient for different climate zones in a moderate climate.

articleTitle: Using of Four-Dimensional Electromagnetic Potentials in Cases of Movement. : Part I: Basic definitions
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This work considers relativistic computational models and approach. They are used for determination of the electromagnetic field by moving. Two types of fourdimensional potentials for determining of the vectors of the induced electric field and magnetic field by motion in Minkovski space are used. The vectors of electromagnetic field are defined as Maxwell’ s tensor elements and dual Maxwell’ s tensor elements. The four-dimensional 4D electric potential elements are electric vector potential and scalar magnetic potential. The four-dimensional magnetic potential elements are magnetic vector potential and scalar electric potential. The relation between the both four-dimensional potentials and the corresponding field tensors is determined. The duality of the using of two types four-dimensional potentials and electromagnetic Maxwell’ s tensors are shown. A variable magnetic charge model is introduced.

articleTitle: Augmentation of Farmer’s Income through Non Pesticidal Management (NPM) Input Production: An Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This study investigates the potential of Natural Farming Non Pesticidal Management (NPM) input production as a strategy for enhancing farmer’s income. NPM involves sustainable agricultural practices aimed at reducing or eliminating the application of chemical pesticides while sustaining or enhancing crop yields. Through an economic analysis, this research assesses the financial viability and profitability of Natural Farming NPM input production, considering factors such as investment requirements, variable costs, net income, and benefit-cost ratios. The application of pesticides has negatively impacted soil health, biodiversity, and natural resources. Natural Farming (NF), an Agro-ecological farming method, considered to be effective to address these challenges.A multiple regression model was used to understand the factors affecting the profitability of Natural Farming NPM input business. Experience of farmer in NPM input production and number of cows have significant effect on the gross margin of the NPM input business. BC ratio of NPM input production was found to be 2.11 and vermicomposting has 1.79. The findings contribute to understanding the economic implications of adopting NPM practices and provide insights into strategies for sustainable income augmentation in agriculture.

articleTitle: Optimum regime parameters in electrical networks with connected decentralized energy sources
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents a developed methodology and software for calculating the optimum mode parameters in an electric power distribution network with connected decentralized energy sources. The sequence of actions in calculating the optimum mode parameters under selected criteria and constraints is described. The results of the calculations for a specific electrical distribution network are presented.

articleTitle: Study of the change of ultrafiltration polymer membranes specific electrical conductivity
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The object of research in the article is specific electrical conductivity of vacuum metallized polymer membranes. Vacuum metallization of polymer membranes as part of their modification is a relatively new element in polymer science and combines very well the performance properties of metals and polymers. Several technological factors, such as the condition of the polymer surface and the parameters of the metallization process, are of great importance for the formation of the metal coating.

articleTitle: A Concept of an IoT-Based System for Monitoring the Operation Parameters of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The information, provided by vehicles to their drivers is crucial for their reliable operation. This study presents an IoT-based concept for vehicles monitoring, aimed at increasing the fault-free operation time and reliability. It includes the architecture of the proposed system, which collects information from the vehicle’s CANBUS network and additional sensors. All information is transmitted to a cloud database using GPRS and/or WiFi connectivity, where the data is analyzed. In the study is also presented a block diagram of the IoT system, presenting its main block, modules and their function. Furthermore, the communication between the IoT devices, the server and the client are presented with the help of an activity diagram. Finally, the logic behind the proposed system is summarized with the help of a flow-chart diagram.

articleTitle: Study of the Influence of Pre-Sowing Electromagnetic Treatments on the Length and Mass of Cotton Plant Sprouts After Long-Term Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this paper, the laboratory test results of the pre-sowing electromagnetic treatment of cotton seeds of the variety “Chirpan 539°”, performed after long storage of the seeds prior to the electromagnetic impact, are described. The presowing electromagnetic treatments of seeds stored for 3 years resulted in an increase in their germination percentage by $(107.8 \ldots 110.8) \% / \mathrm{C}$ compared to the control seeds. After a storage period of 1 year and following the electromagnetic treatment, the lengths of the sprouts increased up to $112.1 \% / \mathrm{C}$ compared to control seeds. To achieve a complex effect on the growth of the sprouts in length and mass, it was proposed that the three-step pre-sowing electromagnetic treatment be carried out using values of the controlled variables voltage $U, \kappa V$ and duration of exposure $\tau, \mathrm{s}$, as follows: $\mathrm{U}_{\mathrm{l}}=8 \mathrm{KV}$ and $\tau_{1}=5 \mathrm{~s}, \mathrm{U}_{2}=6.5 \kappa V$ and $\tau_{2}=25 \mathrm{~s}, U_{3}=5 \kappa V$ and $\tau_{3}=35 \mathrm{~s}$.

articleTitle: Modeling of business processes in the conditions of green economy growth
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to study the influence of the trend on the growth of the green economy on classical economic and mathematical models. The paper considers the features of applying mathematical modeling to optimize production based on a modified model of the transport problem in the context of the growth of the green economy. The research is based on the analysis of the concept of green economy, modeling of business processes in the conditions of green economy growth and application of mathematical methods of linear programming. The solution of the problem is given by means of information technologies. The analysis and modeling of business processes showed the importance of taking into account among the parameters of the mathematical model the costs of product and waste utilization, as well as savings from the possible recycling of raw materials and production waste. On the example of a modified model of the transportation problem the possibilities of analyzing the forecast results of business processes with and without taking into account these parameters are shown. The obtained results have shown that, firstly, the trend of green economy growth affects classical business processes, and it is necessary to take into account new parameters, conditions and changes when modeling economic processes for the efficiency of the waste management system. Secondly, classical mathematical models can be adapted to model the economy in the conditions of green economy growth by including additional parameters in the models - costs of disposal, recycling of production waste, etc.

articleTitle: Electrochemical properties of phycocyanin, extracted from Spirulina by green methods
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Phycocyanin is a protein obtained from different species of blue-green algae. Some algae, such as Arthrospira platensis and Arthrospira maxima, commonly referred to as Spirulina, are known to synthesize C-phycocyanin - a blue and water-soluble pigment. Besides being used as a natural pigment in the food industry, interest in C-phycocyanin has increased due to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticarcinogenic properties. For this reason, it is used in the pharmaceutical industry as an ingredient in food supplements. Our investigation focuses on two electrochemical methods that allow further study of the biophysical properties of the compound - electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) and cyclic voltammetry (CV). The purpose of this study is the investigation of the electrochemical properties of phycocyanin. The obtained results provide valuable information about the specific influence of the protein on aqueous solution.

articleTitle: Optimizing Energy Efficiency: Dynamic Numerical Simulation for Educational Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In today’s context of rising energy prices and the implementation of European energy policies, which also apply to Romania, the imperative to reduce energy consumption has become increasingly pressing, even for older existing buildings. To address this challenge, we conducted dynamic simulations using DesignBuilder software. We employed a Testo 885-2 thermal imager to identify building leakages and heat loss, and a Testo 435 equipment to measure thermal transmittances for walls and roof, with these values serving as crucial inputs for the DesignBuilder simulations. Our study compared five distinct scenarios from both technical and economic standpoints: the existing real-case, the Nearly Zero Energy Building (nZEB) solution according to Romanian legislation (2 scenarios), and the passive building case (2 scenarios). The primary energy consumption decreased significantly by $86.95 \%$ when transitioning from the initial case to meet Romanian nZEB requirements, and by $87.6 \%$ when aiming for passive house standards. In terms of economic feasibility, the nZEB scenario ($3^{\text {th }}$ one) exhibited a 15-year payback period, even without external funding from various governmental programs. This research underscores the potential for substantial energy savings and economic benefits achievable through energy-efficient building solutions.

articleTitle: General methodology determination of the total greenhouse gas generated by conventional and robotic crops
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Feeding us is becoming a increasingly serious problem that different countries will face. The nutrients contained in crops are vital for the health and maintenance of the body in optimal health. Separately, some crops are considered technical and serve as raw material for the production of biofuels or their use in industry. However, the production of agricultural produce itself is associated with the generation of a certain amount of greenhouse gases, Like any industrial production. The correct determination of these gases will provide guidance for their reduction through the introduction of new alternative production technologies. Naturally, these technologies will be applicable in an individual approach.This article discusses the general methodology of the determination of greenhouse gases that are generated in the production of different agricultural products. The methodology concerns the ways of determining the greenhouse gases generated at each stage of agricultural production by the conventional method through the existing mechanization. The methodology makes it possible to compare the greenhouse gases generated in one way or another of cultivation, also affecting alternative methods.

articleTitle: Designing Oscillating Circuits: A Combined Approach with MATLAB and MicroCAP for Synthesis and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper presents a combined approach for synthesizing and analyzing sectioned oscillating (resonant) circuits with capacitive and inductive dividers and transformers with a tuned oscillating circuit. The synthesis is performed using the MATLAB program, and the analysis of the designed oscillating circuits, after selecting standard values for the capacitors in the synthesized circuits, is conducted using the MicroCAP program, used for simulating analog and digital circuits. The results will be utilized in the learning process of the “Communication Circuits” course, which is studied by students specializing in “Internet and Mobile Communications” as part of their Bachelor’s degree program.

Author Keywords: sectioned oscillating circuits with capacitive and inductive dividers
transformers with a tuned oscillating circuit

articleTitle: Management by objectives: modeling the investment policy of service enterprises from the perspective of the digital economy
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The article proposes a step-by-step solution to the problem of modeling investment policy. With a fairly extensive list of methods currently available, the authors preferred a methodology based on the digital economy paradigm. The digital economy is positioned as an economy based on the use of information technologies for optimal resource management, in this case, enterprises. The modeling task is solved in three stages: the formation of an algorithm, the development of a flowchart, and the writing of a computer program. The demand for modeling is dictated by the presence of a large information array, and identifying the optimal solution to the problem is impossible without optimization models. A fairly extensive sequence of calculation procedures can only be performed using computer programs.

articleTitle: Gaseous fuel preparation for power plants using a new adsorbent-indicator from solid waste from industrial and energy complex enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Gaseous waste from petrochemical enterprises is an alternative resource-saving raw material for generating electrical and thermal energy. Gaseous waste can be used as fuel only after its preliminary purification, taking into account the multicomponent composition. The requirements for the content of hydrogen sulfide and mercaptan sulfur in the resulting gaseous fuel are especially seriously monitored and standardized. Most often, adsorption purification methods are used to remove sulfur compounds. The paper presents research on the development and laboratory testing of an indicator sorbent. The indicator sorbent is necessary to determine the degree of saturation of the main adsorbent and to capture “slipped through” sulfur compounds. The indicator sorbent is poured in a second layer on top of the main adsorbent and, upon contact with sulfur compounds, changes color from light gray to deep yellow, depending on the quantitative sulfur content.

articleTitle: Water Distribution by Self Balanced Non-automated Facilities in Irrigation Canals
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In the exploitation of the irrigation systems, the water distribution nodes are subject to wear and tear of the mechanisms and devices for regulating the water levels, as well as the design characteristics of the outflow, and as a consequence the magnitude of the prescribed water quantity, which is intended to be distributed in a lateral or other type of branch canal, is violated. It is therefore necessary to implement an adjustment algorithm for elevating of the water distribution shields in the canals to compensate for the variation of the projected design characteristics for water distribution. In this way, the influence and variation of the water quantity of the flow, the overestimation of the roughness coefficient, the velocity indices and the depth of flow in the canal, etc., will be taken into account and considered. For these reasons, this paper deals with water distribution in open canals for irrigation in condition of steady flow. Analytical equations and method about this type of distribution are shown. This type of water distribution, without or minimized underpropped condition avoiding a backwater effect of the flow in irrigation canal, ensure an increasing level of energy efficiency in irrigation technologies employed in practice with open canals in agriculture.

articleTitle: Some Considerations Regarding Obtaining Hydrogen by Electrolysis
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Hydrogen is an alternative fuel of the future with a number of benefits over fossil fuels. Water is the main source of hydrogen, which is seen as the best renewable and nonpolluting fuel on the planet. The article presents an analysis of the performance of hydrogen making by electrolysis. For the evaluation of hydrogen production, a measurement system was developed based on a specific sensor for hydrogen and another sensor for combustible gases. The designed measurement system is a fast, robust and safe solution for evaluating the electrolysis process, by analyzing the resulting gases. Current intensity, solution concentration and the nature of the catalyst in the solution were considered as influence parameters. The experiment reveals results from the comparison of the different configuration of the operation of the electrolysis cell. The main goal is to analyze the efficiency of the electrolysis process. Some results were expected and others were interesting

articleTitle: Ventilation Effect on the Particulate Concentration in Educational Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Ensuring optimal indoor air quality (IAQ) in educational institutions remains a paramount concern for safeguarding the health and well-being of students. Within classroom environments, elevated concentrations of various pollutants, including particulate matter (PM), are commonly observed. Extensive research underscores the detrimental impact of PM on student’s health, particularly those susceptible to respiratory conditions such as asthma. This study endeavors to assess PM concentrations through an experimental investigation conducted in two comparable classrooms, matched in terms of size, orientation, and occupancy. The sole disparity between the classrooms lies in the ventilation strategy, with one being ventilated with fresh air while the other remains unventilated. Utilizing two GRIMM measurement devices, indoor PM levels were monitored over a span of two days. Results indicate the efficacy of the ventilation system, particularly in mitigating larger PM (PM10) concentrations, whereas comparable outcomes were observed for smaller particles (PM1). A notable reduction in PM concentration, averaging between 10% to 15% in mean values, was calculated. These findings affirm the multifaceted benefits of implementing proper ventilation systems in educational settings for enhancing IAQ.

articleTitle: Implementing a Direct Connection Between Employers and Graduates by Means of a Web based Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper presents some of the ideas, implemented in a web-based platform that improves the relationship between employers and graduates. The structure and algorithm for effective communication between the two parties, simplifying the recruitment process and providing flexibility in scheduling meetings is presented. The communication includes registration, contact database, meeting scheduling, digital communication and strict security and privacy measures.

articleTitle: An experimental investigation of the stroke of the nozzle needle on hydraulic characteristics of electromagnetic fuel injectors
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Electromagnetic fuel injectors play a crucial role in modern internal combustion engines, determining the precise delivery of fuel into the combustion chamber. The stroke of the nozzle needle within these injectors affects their hydraulic characteristics, influencing parameters such as fuel flow rate, injection timing, and spray pattern. This paper investigates the impact of varying the stroke of the nozzle needle on the hydraulic behavior of electromagnetic injectors through experimental analysis. We chose to focus our study on the first generation of electromagnetic injectors, specifically the BOSCH CRI1 model. Our experiments were conducted using a versatile test platform designed for CMX 6000 X diesel fuel systems. Results indicate significant dependencies between nozzle needle stroke and injector performance, highlighting the importance of optimizing this parameter for efficient and effective fuel delivery. Understanding these hydraulic characteristics is vital for enhancing engine performance, emissions control, and overall fuel efficiency.

articleTitle: Model for Thermal Studies of Automotive Engine Cylinder Heads
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The present paper delves into the process of developing a model for thermal studies of cylinder heads through the use of SolidWorks software environment. Described is the method for constructing a finite element mesh, along with the methodology for determining unknown boundary conditions, by analyzing the collected experimental data regarding the cylinder head temperatures. To validate the model’s accuracy, a comparison is conducted between the temperature values, collected at specific points, acquired through experimentation, and generated by the thermal model hereto proposed.

articleTitle: Experimental pasture model with remote access of the data
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The result of modern industrial production of agricultural products led to the destruction of natural ecosystems and the disappearance of many of them. Water scarcity in huge areas and increased demand for water is common. There has been a violation of the geochemical cycle of substances, water and radiation regimes in agroecological natural systems. There is erosion and salinization of the soil along with drying, depletion and. This has led to the drastic reduction of pastures or their existence in wet periods of time.This paper aims to create a model pasture system that mimics with some accuracy the microclimatic conditions for the growth of grass mixtures. The system has remote access to the data and different growth conditions can be modeled in it.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of development of modern agricultural cooperation
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Modern cooperation in the Russian Federation has a number of features in its development. One of the main characteristics is the predominance of the economic sphere in this process. Cooperative enterprises and organizations play an important role in the country’s economy, providing citizens with the opportunity to actively participate in entrepreneurial activities. Modern cooperation is also characterized by its flexibility and adaptability to changing market conditions. Cooperatives are actively using new technologies and management methods to improve the efficiency of their work. This allows them to compete successfully in the market and ensure sustainable development. Cooperatives make it possible to create jobs and ensure the well-being of citizens, especially in small and medium-sized cities and towns. They are a powerful tool of social support and development. Cooperation also contributes to the development of small and medium-sized businesses. Cooperatives create conditions for small businesses to cooperate, providing them with access to resources, markets and expert support. Cooperation plays an important role not only in the economy of the country, but also in the social sphere, contributing to the improvement of the quality of life of citizens and the development of small and medium-sized businesses. The aim of the research is to study the peculiarities of the development of modern cooperation in the Russian Federation and to develop recommendations for improvement.

articleTitle: Experimental Study Of Photovoltaic Panels’ Degradation And Technology Evolution
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper studies the degradation of the performances of photovoltaic (PV) panels during the years of operation, which is crucial for owners of PV installations of different scales and in urban or rural areas. PV panels produced by five different technologies are investigated using experimental data from five grid-connected photovoltaic systems installed in Sofia, Bulgaria. The data cover ten years of operation under continental climate various meteorological conditions. The results of the study allow a more informed choice of suitable panel technology during the design and sizing process of PV systems. Finally, a brief comparison of the performance of different generations of PV panels is made.

articleTitle: Study of Voltage Stability in Microgrid with PV
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this article, a microgrid with a connected photovoltaic plant is considered. The model is implemented at low voltage and is powered by a 20 kV substation. In a software environment, simulation studies of the proposed network have been done in two cases when the connected loads change. An analysis of voltage stability in both cases was made and a comparison was made between them. The presented studies are useful in determining a suitable connection node of a photovoltaic plant.

articleTitle: Risk Management in Farming: An Overview of Sources, Decision-making and Reduction Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The paper considers risk management and strategies for risk reduction in farming. Different sources of risk are presented that happen on farms. The paper reveals some approaches to farmer’s decision-making to reduce the risk. An algorithm is proposed which can be applied to risk management in farms. The cycle of decision-making in farms is visually presented. Graphical representation is also available for risk management strategies. The paper presents an overview of the risk management and risk management strategies in farms.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency-oriented Entrepreneurship or Entrepreneurship-oriented Energy Efficiency Initiatives: A Future Experts’ Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is twofold: first, to introduce the concepts of energy efficiency-oriented entrepreneurship and entrepreneurship-oriented energy efficiency, and second, to reveal how future experts answer the question of which of the two is needed more for the overall energy efficiency improvement. The research design of the study is qualitative. Empirical data is obtained through a combination of exploratory and descriptive research strategies. Energy efficiency-oriented entrepreneurship is defined as a proactive attitude or readiness to seek, create, and discover opportunities to improve energy efficiency in existing business organizations, while entrepreneurship-oriented energy efficiency is related to the provision of opportunities for enterprises to use less energy when performing the same tasks or achieving the same results. According to the future experts, involved in the survey, entrepreneurship-oriented energy efficiency initiatives are more needed as a starting point for the development of a sustainable economy, but energy efficiency-oriented entrepreneurship is more important.

articleTitle: Outdoor VOCs’ Concentration Monitoring Due to Traffic Emission
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: In this study, the measurement of outdoor pollution within the campus of the Faculty of Building Services of Bucharest was conducted. The values of the pollutants examined are approaching the maximum permissible limits, which may pose health problems. The level of pollution was compared based on existing climatic data, during rainy days and sunny days. The measurements were carried out using the mobile laboratory of the Faculty of Building Services of Bucharest, which can determine the level of pollution for the following compounds: CO, particles (PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> and PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>), $\mathrm{O}_{3}, \mathrm{SO}_{2}, \mathrm{NO}_{2}, \mathrm{NO}, \mathrm{CO}$, and VOCs (benzene, toluene, xylene, and ethylbenzene, compounds referred to as BTEX). The mobile laboratory is a new type of monitoring device and is able to measure independently anywhere having also an energy generator.

articleTitle: Analysis of Test Data on the Use of Agras MG-1S UAV for Plant Protection in Precision Farming
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of using the Agras MG-1S UAV for plant protection in precision farming, drawing on contemporary experience with UAVs in agriculture. The article outlines the benefits of UAVs compared to traditional methods and explores ways to enhance this technology by optimizing the transport and technological cycles of agricultural UAVs used for spraying liquid fertilizers and pesticides. The analysis focuses on two key aspects: the impact of flight speed and altitude on the degree of coverage and their influence on pesticide permeability. The optimal flight parameters for spraying corn crops during the reproductive growth stage are presented.

articleTitle: Interface for monitoring of electrical and non electrical data on bard a vessel
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The development of maritime transport is characterized by the use of a wide variety of ships and marine equipment. Increasing their efficiency requires the use of SCADA, with the help of which thousands of parameters are controlled. SCADA systems solve the following tasks: hierarchical control, analysis and arrangement of controlled parameters, creation of a database, a system for diagnostics of ship equipment. The article discusses the main features of the SCADA created by the authors, with the main attention being paid to the interface. The research shows that synchronization is crucial for reducing power disturbances and assuring the dependability of shipboard electrical systems. While automatic synchronization shows promise, our studies reveal areas that need improvement, namely with sensor precision and timing inconsistencies. By providing these data, we enhance the comprehension of how synchronization affects the safety and operational efficiency of maritime vessels, emphasizing the necessity for continuous improvement of shipboard power systems. This paper contributes to the field of electrical engineering by highlighting the importance of improving synchronization techniques for marine applications and other industries that depend on dispersed power systems.

articleTitle: Investigating the Challenges of Monitoring Open-Pit Mining Slope Conditions for the Safe Operation of Earthmoving and Construction Machinery
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This paper explores the issue of monitoring the condition of quarry slopes, which is critical for ensuring the safety of earth-moving and construction machinery operations. It summarizes the factors affecting the slope condition and the circumstances under which hazards arise. The existing monitoring methods and their capabilities in addressing the issue were analyzed. The main technologies used for slope condition monitoring were examined. The conclusion highlights the need for developing an integrated monitoring system utilizing drones, which will allow for prompt response to changes in the slope condition and ensure the safety of earthmoving and construction machinery operations.

articleTitle: Training of Professionals on PV Systems in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The article presents the experience of a team from Ruse University “Angel Kanchev” (RUAK) in organizing and conducting training for installers of photovoltaic systems. These trainings are a response to the rapidly increased growth of photovoltaic (PV) plants in the country in recent years. Taking into account the qualification frameworks of the National Agency for Training and Education, a curriculum, theoretical part, and practical exercises have been developed. The offered trainings are met with interest by the business, and their results are positive.

articleTitle: Profile length measurement system using USB camera
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Monitoring the size of products from extrusion machines is of great importance in the field of production. Although most extruding and developing machines have control over the length of the required parts, sometimes visual control of the products is also required. In industry, different types of sensors are used to monitor and control the exact dimensions of products, but in some cases, it is very difficult to choose a suitable sensor due to the specifics of the material of the product. This article presents the development of a theoretical model applied in software for monitoring the length of cut car seals via PC with USB cameras. Made a PLC controller and software to work with up to 10 cameras and set the fields for monitoring the details, working under Windows OS.

articleTitle: Inhibitory effect of ethanol extract of bilberry on aluminium alloy corrosion EN AW-2024
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The inhibitory effect of ethanol extract of bilberry on the corrosion of aluminium alloy EN AW 2024 in 1M HCl was investigated using gravimetric and metallographic methods and the variation of anthocyanin absorption in the studied extract with time was monitored. By statistical processing of the data with the SPSS 25.0 product, the existence of a correlation relationship between the quantities time and the presence of inhibitor on the corrosion rate was investigated. The results showed that bilberry extract exhibited a good inhibitory effect on the corrosion of EN AW 2024 aluminum alloy in 1M hydrochloric acid and with increasing concentration of bilberry extract the inhibitory effect increased.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis of Flyback DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This article presents a harmonic resonance analysis of the Flyback DC-DC converter. Harmonic resonance analysis of DC-DC converters is a process that considers specific conditions where the harmonic components generated by the converters can interact with the reactive elements in the system (such as inductors and capacitors), leading to the phenomenon of resonance. This type of analysis is critical because harmonic resonance can significantly increase the voltage and/or current at certain points in the system, which can lead to component failure or system instability. A mathematical model was implemented in MATLAB/Simulink, with the help of which simulation results are presented when a disturbance unit is injected into each node of the studied power scheme.

articleTitle: Analysis of Synchronization Process of Synchronous Generators in Shipboard Power Systems: A Laboratory Study
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: This study investigates the automated synchronization and desynchronization processes of synchronous generators (SGs) in a controlled laboratory environment, intending to replicate power systems seen aboard ships. The goal of this paper is to provide insight into the challenges of maintaining electrical stability and efficiency in maritime power situations by examining the integration and separation of a synchronous generator (SG) with a busbar system. Through the experimental analysis, we recorded changes in voltage and current during these operations, which allowed us to thoroughly examine the operational dynamics and identify potential issues. The research shows that synchronization is crucial for reducing power disturbances and assuring the dependability of shipboard electrical systems. While automatic synchronization shows promise, our studies reveal areas that need improvement, namely with sensor precision and timing inconsistencies. By providing these data, we enhance the comprehension of how synchronization affects the safety and operational efficiency of maritime vessels, emphasizing the necessity for continuous improvement of shipboard power systems. This paper contributes to the field of electrical engineering by highlighting the importance of improving synchronization techniques for marine applications and other industries that depend on dispersed power systems.

articleTitle: Advantages and Disadvantages of Energy Storage Systems for Energy Produced by Small and Medium Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The use of renewable energy sources to generate electricity is a pre-condition for the use of energy storage devices to allow the energy to be exploited fully at the point of generation. This report discusses the advantages and disadvantages of different electricity storage facilities.

articleTitle: Macroeconomic Factors Affecting the Value Added Tax Receipts in The Consolidated Budget
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The relevance of the study is determined by the presence of various approaches that define the role of value-added tax (VAT) in macroeconomic regulation. The aim of the research is to analyze scientific views on the impact of VAT on macroeconomic parameters of the Russian economy, as well as to substantiate macroeconomic factors influencing VAT receipts into the consolidated budget. The research methodology is based on principles recognizing taxation as an effective tool for macroeconomic regulation. The study employs general scientific methods, as well as correlation and regression analysis. The results of the scientific research presented in the article allow establishing a close relationship between VAT receipts into the consolidated budget and expenditures on final consumption, household income, inflation, gross domestic product, import and export volumes, as well as investment in fixed capital. The obtained results can be used to justify proposals for improving the calculation and payment procedures of VAT in order to ensure sustainable growth of the Russian economy.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Possible Solar Range and Economic Viability of Solar Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The work presents some of the few companies offering solar battery electric vehicles (SBEVs) on the market today. The possible range of an example SBEV, equipped with modern efficient PV cells, is calculated. The average daily solar range for Germany is 12.23 km, which is close to the claimed 16 km by the Sion. For Bulgaria it is 15.28 km daily, or 19.2 km for the Sion. These solar ranges are enough for most of the daily European needs, and close to the halve needed by the average American driver. The PV system investment return period is on average from 1 to 4.5 years for EU, and 2 to 8 years for USA. The conclusion is that the PV technology has developed enough to allow SBEVs to become useful and economically viable in daily commuting. The integrated PV system improves the economic viability of battery electric vehicles (BEVs), by lowering the driving costs and partially compensating for some of the expensive battery drawbacks. More SBEVs are expected to appear on the market in the coming years.

articleTitle: A Platform for the Development of Software Applications for the Control of Power Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The manuscript presents several platforms for the development and synthesis of numerical control of power electronic devices and systems based on the use of Matlab. The possibilities of applying modern means of modeling, mathematical software and information and communication technologies for the implementation of digital controllers are considered. In this way, it becomes possible to implement flexible and adaptive control of electronic converters, and also to apply an innovative approach in power electronics training. On this basis, possible specific applications of the described configuration in a photovoltaic system, where monitoring of the mode of maximum power output from the photovoltaic generator is implemented, are considered and described.

articleTitle: Pasture Biomass Research Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles are using often on research in deferent areas. Pasture research is one of them and include data brings and analysis for many of parameters that give an information about grassy, biomass, slope of terrain etc. This study present similar data analysis that bring with drone at area designed for cattle pasture in Rodopa Mountain in Bulgaria. Studied parameter is volume with grass vegetation using photogrammetry. Result obtained covered three-year study period, from 2021 to 2023 year. Two methods have been used to analyze the volume - Digital Surface Model (DSM) and Digital Terrain Model (DTM), comparing that which must be added or removed to level the surface with the surrounding land. The research and analysis of the results showed it requires additional researches to applicate of the presented method for determining the volume and amount of grass for low-height grazing on designated pastures.

articleTitle: Study of the Presence of Pulse Width Modulated Flicker of the LED Display Backlight
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The most fundamental weakness of the LCD displays is the flickering of their backlight as a result of pulse width modulation used to manage the brightness. For most users this causes migraines, fatigue or milder forms of discomfort during longer work in front of the display. The reason for this is the backlight flashing with a frequency between $100 \div 700 \mathrm{~Hz}$, which causes numerous contractions and expansions of the pupils of the human eyes. This frequency should not be confused with the refresh rate of the screen. Especially harmful is the flickering of the LED displays, which are not inert and affect the vision much more aggressively. The paper presents a convenient method for studying the backlight flicker on displays without having to disassemble them.

articleTitle: Simulation Verification of Studies of Thermoelectric Cooling System
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The simulation of various processes in the practice has long become an essential instrument for the design, as well as the study and optimization of diverse systems. A properly structured and intuitive software environment is a powerful tool for modeling a system and improving its performance, while saving significant time, labor, and materials. This paper applies a reversed approach by presenting the verification of the results obtained during an experimental study of a real thermoelectric cooling system, using software.

articleTitle: The influence of location accuracy on the estimation of crops with a budget UAV in Dobrudja
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Monitoring vegetation processes through reflectance indices is very important for precision agriculture. Uncertainty in the position of the integrated cameras in DJI Mavic 2 pro and DJI Phantom 4 pro as well as an additional mounted MAPIR camera were investigated. The deviations along X, Y and Z were analysed. The obtained data show a small error along X and Y and a large one along Z. Analysis of the results of the received reflection maps show that there is no dependence on the wind gusts. And a weak dependence on the RMS error of the geolocation obtained from the processed data and Area Covered.

articleTitle: LQR-based PID Control of DC Motor Speed
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: The aim of this study is to synthesis a LQR-based PID controller and compare the results of using such a controller with these from systems with a PID controller and a LQR controller. The comparison proves that the LQR-based PID controller is more efficient by 6.59% reduction in energy consumption than a system with a PID controller. Furthermore, it is shown that such controller increases only with 1.73% energy consumption as opposed to LQ regulator. Also, this paper presents the advantage of the LQR-based PID controller regarding the avoidance of additional feedback on armature current.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Production of Hydrochar from Straw
publicationTitle: 2024 9th International Conference on Energy Efficiency and Agricultural Engineering (EE&AE)
abstract: Straw hydrochar production contributes to sustainable agriculture. This work presents an experimental study for hydrochar production from biochar by hydrothermal carbonization. The experiments were conducted at three different temperatures: 400°C, 600°C, and 800°C. Elemental analyses were made on the samples obtained, and the results of these investigations are presented and discussed.
